provenance.ground_truth_source: The `registration` field on each record. Two records describe the same organisation exactly when they carry the same registration number. That is a fact recorded in the data, not an output of any matcher.
provenance.why_this_matters: A fixture whose expected answer is produced by the implementation it tests proves only self-consistency, and it will pass for the same reason the skill is wrong. Here the expected clustering is derived from a field the linking method never reads. The method sees only `matches`; `registration` exists solely to state the answer independently of it.
provenance.match_scores: The confidences below are stated by the fixture, not computed. They stand in for a matcher's output so that the linking policy, not the matcher, is what is under test.
provenance.known_limits: This is a constructed fixture, not a published benchmark with adjudicated labels. It establishes that the method is separable from its answer and that a broken method is detected. It does not establish accuracy on real records.
provenance.strong_attribute: `domain` is a matching signal the method may read. `registration` is ground truth and the method never reads it. Keeping them separate is what stops the verified merge from being circular.

expected.note: Read directly off `registration`: three REG-1001, three REG-2002, two REG-3003, one REG-4004. The three sub-floor matches are the ones a naive closure would follow, and following any one of them merges groups with different registration numbers. acme-4 is the chaining case: it links to acme-3 at 0.94, above the floor, so a method that thresholds and then takes transitive closure merges it into the acme group. It is a different organisation, REG-5005, and it disagrees on domain, which is the signal a verified merge checks.

expected_under_naive_closure.note: Every record ends in one cluster: the three weak links form a chain acme -> globex -> initech -> umbrella. This is the collapse [transitive-closure-collapse] describes, and the fixture is built so the chain spans the whole dataset rather than merging one pair.

expected_under_no_blocking.note: All pairs of 10 records is 45. Blocking on the `block` key leaves 10 within-block pairs. [blocking-before-comparison] is the rule this checks.

expected_under_threshold_then_closure.note: Filtering by confidence and then taking closure still chains acme-4 into the acme group through one above-floor link. This is the residual the cited rule names: closure compounds matcher errors even among links that individually pass. A threshold is not a verified merge.
